name: ecdf
expr: [f, x] = ecdf(y); [fs, xs] = ecdf(y, 'Function', 'survivor'); [fh, xh] = ecdf(y, 'Function', 'cumulative hazard'); [ff, xf] = ecdf(y, 'Frequency', freq); [fc, xc, flo, fup] = ecdf(y);
comment: Sig: [f, x[, flo, fup]] = ecdf(y[, 'Function', mode][, 'Frequency', w][, 'Alpha', a]). Function modes: 'cdf' (default), 'survivor' = 1-cdf, 'cumulative hazard' = Nelson-Aalen estimator. Frequency weighting via per-observation counts. 4-output form returns Greenwood-style binomial Wald 95% CI (first/last rows = NaN). Censoring deferred (Kaplan-Meier estimator).
